Yesternerd — copy review

Every screen and state, as a picture, with its wording in an editable box next to it. Generated 07 Aug 2026, 16:06 from edition №71 on branch data in this checkout.

You can stop after Tier 1 and still have covered most of what a player actually reads — Tiers 2 and 3 are folded shut below; open a section only if you want to go further.

To send edits back: change any box you want to fix, then press Copy all my changes at the bottom of the page. Your changes appear in a text box there — select them and copy, then paste into chat. Untouched boxes are left out automatically.

Your edits are saved in this browser as you type, so closing the tab or reloading the page will not lose them.

52 screens/states captured, 48 with a screenshot (the rest are text-only sets — share templates, screen-reader announcements, and the baked-into-artwork stamp — explained where they appear).
